column4: PR #2561: test-support AST scanner for the best-effort-after-commit guard, imported only from the _test.go files of internal/core/guards, server/http/handlers and server/grpc/services, so it is never linked into any production build (confirmed by grep: no non-test file imports it). Pure go/ast analysis -- reads *.go files under a given root, resolves no network, opens no DB, holds no credential, and its only write is none (it returns values). Its own correctness is calibrated by testdata/planted/planted.go.txt, a fixture whose functions are named for the verdict the scanner must reach, asserted in both directions, plus TestScan_DerivedSafetyIsNotTransitive for the one soundness rule a draft got wrong.
